title: For the client who applied the biggest loan, what was his/her first amount
question: For the client who applied the biggest loan, what was his/her first amount of transaction after opened the account?

prediction.sql:
SELECT t.XCL_051
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
JOIN loan AS l ON a.XCL_001 = l.XCL_034
WHERE l.XCL_036 = (SELECT MAX(XCL_036) FROM loan)
  AND t.XCL_048 >= a.XCL_004
ORDER BY t.XCL_048 ASC, t.XCL_046 ASC
LIMIT 1;
